_comment: The list Pup Trails shows in its Trail map panel. Adding a map to the game is a
commit and one line here -- no code change, and nothing to download on the device
`url` is resolved against the page, which lives in trails/ or dist/, so a file in
this folder is ../data/NAME. An absolute https:// URL works too and does not have
to be in this repo; raw.githubusercontent.com sends the CORS header that makes any
The file at the other end may be a pup-world/1 bundle from tools/fetch_dem.py (real
elevation) or a plain GeoJSON FeatureCollection of trails, points and areas (flat
ground). Pup Trails decides which by looking inside, so the extension is irrelevant.
